notes:
Background: mid-market DTC + wholesale marketplace. Catalog ~3.2M SKUs, searchable variants push vector count ~48M after embeddings and metadata variants. Current stack: Elastic with vector plugin + in-house re-ranker (hybrid BM25 + ML reranker). Pain: costs spike during Nov/Dec (Black Friday -> 5x baseline qps), tail latency and cost-per-query blowout when rerank is applied. Evaluation goal: cut end-to-end cost-per-query by 30-50% while meeting 95th percentile latency SLOs under peak.

Call snippets / quotes: "If we can get p95 under 250ms at 5x traffic and cost < $0.003/q, we sign" — Head of Search (Anika Raj). "Need deterministic fallbacks during capacity stress, can't have POI queries degrade to >1s" — CTO.

Security/compliance: requires SSO (SAML + SCIM), KMS integration for key management, audit logs retained 13 months, and EU data residency for EU customers. Legal flagged data retention for user behavior logs.

POC ask: 1) indexing workflow for nightly delta (50–200k new/updated vectors/day), 2) memory/infra estimate for 48M vectors (24-32 bit quantization scenarios), 3) throughput tests at 5x base qps with routing + canary fallback to smaller model, 4) detailed cost-per-query calc (embeddings+ANN+rerank+compute).

Operational notes: prefer managed control plane but VPC egress rules needed; interested in Dedicated for guaranteed throughput with on-demand burst for campaigns. SEs: Jordan to provide perf harness and sample dataset. Next: security questionnaire due 2026-03-12, POC start target 2026-03-15.

use_case_summary: Enterprise RAG/search for e-commerce catalog: produce embeddings for product metadata + user signals, run nearest-neighbor retrieval at large scale, then apply a learned reranker to produce final top-K. Key constraints: keep end-to-end cost-per-query low, maintain tight latency SLOs during 5x seasonal spikes, and support secure VPC deployments with SSO and KMS.
requirements: Target p95 end-to-end latency < 250ms under 5x peak qps
Cost target: <= $0.003 per end-to-end query (retrieval + rerank)
Indexing: nightly delta updates; support 50k-200k vector ops/day without full rebuild
Support for 48M vectors with quantization recommendations
Rerank additional latency budget: <= 50ms for model-in-loop
Operational: Dedicated pool with burst, canary rollouts, audit logs retained 13 months
